title: A housewarming gift they will actually keep
body:
Why most housewarming gifts don't last

The classics are lovely for one evening. A bouquet, a bottle of wine, a box of chocolates. A week later they are gone, and nothing in the new home reminds anyone of the day they got the keys. The gifts that stay are the ones that are about the home itself: where it is, what it means and the life that is starting there.

What makes a good housewarming gift

  • It is personal. It could only have been made for them, for this address.
  • It fits any interior. New homeowners are particular about their walls, so calm colours and a good frame matter.
  • It is easy to live with. No care, no assembly, no clutter.

Seven ideas that last

  1. A map of their new street. Their own neighbourhood, drawn as a print, with a small house on their front door and the year they moved in.
  2. A good plant in a good pot. Pick one that forgives forgotten watering, like a snake plant or a ZZ plant.
  3. A guest book for the hallway. Every visitor in the first year leaves a line.
  4. A set of house keys made special. A leather key ring with the house number or the date.
  5. A first dinner. Cook it, or bring everything for it, on the day they still have no idea where the pans are.
  6. A frame for the first photo. Take a picture of them in front of the door and give it framed.
  7. A local guide. Your favourite bakery, café and walk in their new area, written by hand.

How to make a map of their new home

A map print is the one gift on this list that hangs on the wall for years, so here is how to get it right.

1. Search the address and choose the zoom

Zoom in close to show their street and the houses around it, or zoom out to show the neighbourhood with the park, the river or the canal they now live by. For a first flat in a big city, the whole centre often looks beautiful.

2. Choose colours for their interior

Light palettes suit bright, Scandinavian rooms. Dark palettes with gold or copper lines look rich in a living room with wood and leather. If you are unsure, a calm neutral palette works almost everywhere.

3. Add the words

  • Our first home with the year they got the keys
  • The street name and house number
  • Their family name, for example The Johnsons · since 2026

4. Mark the house

Place a small house pin exactly on their front door. It is the detail people point at when friends come round.

5. Pick the size and the frame

30×40 cm is a perfect gift size for a hallway or a kitchen. For the living room, 50×70 cm. Choose a frame in the colour of their furniture, or send the print alone if they like to frame things themselves. Not sure? Our guide to sizes and frames shows every option to scale.

When to give it

At the housewarming itself, or a few weeks after the move, once the boxes are gone and the walls are still empty. You can also have it sent straight to their new address: every print is made to order close to them and usually arrives within 3 to 7 working days in Europe.

Looking for more ideas for a new home? See our housewarming gift guide.
summary: Flowers fade and the wine is gone by midnight. Here is how to choose a housewarming gift that still means something years later, with seven ideas and a step by step guide to a map of their new home.
